sources.snippet: This is the prefilling FastWAM-ICL checkpoint trained on the pick_fruits subset of wushr-lance/VLA2Vec. Both ICL variants start from the exact same FastWAM T-Rex baseline at step 27,708 and use the same manually audited, fixed EgoDex reference.

sources.snippet: FastWAM is now faster, better suited to large-scale datasets, and more flexible for research. This update brings substantially faster training and inference, native LeRobot v3.0 support, and a new model that can switch between acting with and without future imagination.

sources.title: Fast-WAM: Do World Action Models Need Test-time Future Imagination?
sources.snippet: Abstract World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for embodied control because they explicitly model how visual observations may evolve under action.
